name: Iori
message: 「Whoa, it's already noon?」
After running into Setsugekka and Momiji at the arena and chatting with Asahi-chan afterward, it was past noon before I knew it.
When I accessed the academy's attendance system, it showed that Tobe Ririmu, a student in Takamura Class, was out sick.
So I figured she must be in the dorms and came all the way here, but...

name: Iori
message: 「Wait a second, am I even allowed to go up to the 4th floor？」
Murakumo Academy is a full boarding school, so both boys and girls spend all three years in this dorm.
Every student is given a private room equipped with the latest full-HR-controlled facilities, and they're free to bring in TVs and games too.
However, there is one strict taboo in this dorm that must never be broken.
Guys are forbidden from going up to the 4th floor or higher. That's where the girls' private rooms and the communal bath are.
Naturally, Tobe Ririmu's room would be on the 4th floor or above. I'm a teacher now so I feel like it should be fine, yet I'm still a little uneasy about it.

name: Iori
message: 「...Guess I should check with Sasaki-sensei.」
So as I brought up my holographic display and fiddled with the screen to send a message.
「Fwaaah... I slept so well.」
A familiar-looking student came walking out of the dorm.

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, Tobe Ririmu-san？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hm？ How do you know who I am？」
I knew it. The girl standing right in front of me matched the headshot on her profile.

name: Iori
message: 「I'm Muragaki Iori—starting today, I'm the assistant homeroom teacher for your class, Takamura Class. I was actually just about to come say hello.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, whatever.」
Giving a half-hearted reply, she walked briskly off.

name: Iori
message: 「H-Hey, wait, wait！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whaaat？ I've got stuff to do, you know.」

name: Iori
message: 「What kind of stuff？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Mmm, do I really have to tell you, Teach？」

name: Iori
message: 「Uh, yeah, you do！ Technically, we're still in the middle of class, you know！？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Even if you say that~」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Not a siiingle teacher at this academy can actually teach me properly anyway.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Taking it seriously is kinda just a waste of time~」

name: Iori
message: 「Uh, hmm... I see.」
I'd already heard the rumors that Takamura Class was a class full of nothing but problem students that ordinary teachers couldn't handle.
She must've been transferred into Takamura Class for some kind of issue too.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, long story short, I'm heading to the mainland to go shopping right now. Anyway, see ya, Iorin」

name: Iori
message: 「Iorin？！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Your name's Muragaki Iori, right, Teach？ So, Iorin」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey now, I'm not your friend, you know」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh, there it is, the textbook teacher line」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah, whatever. I'll call you whatever I feel like calling you」
Ah... I'm starting to get a pretty good idea of what kind of girl she is.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Anyway, just stay out of my way」

name: Iori
message: 「No, sorry, but I can't just look the other way while you skip class to go mess around」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, so what are you gonna do about it？ Slap a collar on me and drag me around？」

name: Iori
message: 「Come work up a good, healthy sweat with me！」
I thrust my hand straight out toward Ririmu.

name: Iori
message: 「You're in the Martial Arts Division, aren't you, Ririmu? Then how about sparring with me? I'm sure you'll get something out of it」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're sounding kinda like a hot-blooded gym teacher right now. I'm really not good with that type, y'know」

name: Iori
message: 「Hmm, could it be you're scared of letting me see what you're really made of？ Maybe you're not all that great after all」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, so you're really gonna go there」

name: Ririmu
message: 「My old homeroom teacher said pretty much the same thing and sparred with me, and man, they were totally pathetic」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Everyone said this was the top academy for learning Jindou, so I actually had pretty high hopes for this place」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I figured a teacher at a school like this would obviously be strong, right? Turns out they were suuuper weak, I honestly couldn't help laughing」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Seriously, total 'give me my money back' level」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're probably all talk and nothing special either, aren't you？」

name: Iori
message: 「You don't know someone's skill with a blade until you actually fight them, right？ Talking like that, you might be all talk yourself」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh... big talk, Teach」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Fine, I'll take you on. Don't blame me if you end up crying later」
I brought Ririmu along to the indoor training hall.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hey, I've got a favor to ask」

name: Iori
message: 「Sure, ask away」

name: Ririmu
message: 「If I win this practice match, get down on your hands and knees and grovel, Sensei」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You got in the way of my shopping, after all—I won't be satisfied unless you do at least that much~」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, fine by me」
Is she confident in her own skills, or is she just a sadist? Either way, I have no intention of losing.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm... You're surprisingly confident in your skills, Sensei」

name: Iori
message: 「Of course I am. Come at me whenever you're ready」
With my Origami in hand, I smile at her.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Okay, here I come！」
Ririmu gave a small hop and began bouncing into a nimble rhythm of footwork.
Normally, traditional swordsmanship relies primarily on sliding footwork.
Yet here Ririmu was, stepping lightly as if she were dancing.

name: Iori
message: 「That's an interesting form. What school is it from？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh-heh, this is called the Lily Style」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Because it's my way of doing things—mine and mine alone！！」
The moment I thought she'd made a light leap—
She closed in along a zigzagging path and slashed at me with her drawn blade.

name: Ririmu
message: 「You blocked it~ Then how about this？！」
Just when I thought she'd stepped back a bit, she whipped into a V-turn and struck again. It's a move I've never seen before.
Her erratic trajectory makes her moves hard to read, and I can't easily find an opening to counterattack.

name: Iori
message: 「Fascinating—did you come up with this fighting style yourself？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Totally！ Because this is my worldview！！」
Rough around the edges though it may be, she doesn't follow any established methods.
Developing a brand-new fighting style like this is completely beyond an ordinary swordsman.

name: Iori
message: 「I see, so you built it yourself from scratch. You've got incredible combat instincts！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hehe, are you trying to flatter me？」

name: Iori
message: 「Not at all, I mean it. Next, it's my turn to attack！！」
First, straight from the front, no tricks.

name: Iori
message: 「Hmph！！！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, heavy！」
Followed by a feint, a side sweep into a wrist-turn parry.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh... you’re fast, Sensei！」
Stepping in deep toward Ririmu’s center―I thrust upward at point―blank range.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah, geez, my hands are killing me...！」
Unable to dodge, Ririmu is forced to take the brunt of my blow. Her Origami recoils high into the air.
A torso strike here would end it, but—
Moving in an erratic zigzag, Ririmu escaped my reach. Her movement is so unique that chasing her down is quite the challenge.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whew, not bad, Sensei！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You look young, so I didn't think you’d be this good~, a bit of a surprise.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m happy to have your appraisal.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But that’s not all I’ve got. I’m gonna get serious for the next one.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Try and keep up, Sensei！」
Ririmu’s footwork changed.
Varying her tempo, she drifted—erratic and fluid, sliding in and out of range.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Come on, come on~, are you just gonna watch！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Whoa...！」
I dodge in a hurry—a blade swings from an angle I never expected.

name: Iori
message: 「Nice move, but how’s your defense！？」
I step into range and flash a diagonal strike from above.
But like a butterfly dancing in the air, she slips right past it.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh, you’re not hitting me with that!」
…I see, so this is Ririmu’s true forte.
An elusive style that keeps you guessing, focused entirely on catching opponents off guard. This elusiveness is her signature, isn't it.
In that case, how about this—！？
I close the distance again. Without any tricks, I head straight for her.

name: Ririmu
message: 「What’s that, you making fun of me！？」
Ririmu’s flash comes closing in. Because I charged in so head-on and simple-mindedly, I can't dodge.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ngaaah！？」
But—it was Ririmu who let out the cry.
Give flesh to rend the bone.
I dared to take her strike with my Barrier Jacket, and paid her back with a heavy blow of my own.

name: Ririmu
message: 「You're surprisingly ruthless, Sensei！ Going for a mutual hit in our very first practice？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Haha, I just don't want to end up groveling on the floor.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm, so you're desperate, huh. That's kinda cute.」

name: Iori
message: 「Are you sure you can afford to act so relaxed? One more hit and it's over for you, right?」
Going by the feel of it, that last strike should have dropped Ririmu's VF below half.

name: Ririmu
message: 「No prob, no prob, I'm never gonna get hit again.」

name: Iori
message: 「That's quite the confidence.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yep, 'cause from here on out, it's all my show.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Here I go—World is Mine！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Here I go—

name: Ririmu
message: <d0029>World is Mine</d>！」
For a brief moment, my vision seemed to darken slightly.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Come on, come on, space out and you're gonna get wrecked！！」
The blade of Ririmu's Origami came rushing toward me, and—
Suddenly, Ririmu's blade blurred... and in the next instant, it vanished completely！
My body moved on pure reflex against the approaching threat. I barely managed to deflect the blade.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa, awesome! Do you have eyes in the back of your head or something, Sensei？!」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Still though, a fluke like that ain't gonna last！！」
I spun around at the whistle of the wind, but Ririmu wasn't there.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Where are you looking, Sensei！！」
I missed the parry, and Ririmu chipped away at my VF.

name: Iori
message: 「Is this... an illusion？ Don't tell me you're an illusionist...！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh-heh, surprised？」
They say that back in the Sengoku period, there were Ikusabito who wielded spirit blades to manipulate illusions at will.
However, most of those spirit blades were lost during the <d0043>Edo period</d>, and even among warrior families, few retained strong spiritual power like the Ikusabito of old.
In the modern era, people capable of manifesting a unique Tenju like Ririmu are exceedingly rare.

name: Ririmu
message: 「This is my secret. You better not go blabbing about it to the other kids！」
I swung my Origami in every direction, fending off attacks closing in from outside my field of vision.
I was only managing because Ririmu’s strikes were light; I wouldn't have been able to handle a full-force blow.

name: Iori
message: 「I see, this is a tricky one...！」
A smile crept onto my face. Encountering the unknown like this is exactly why I can’t quit Jindou.

name: Ririmu
message: 「You get it now, right? Only I can use my Tenju.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「My style of fighting is something only I understand. So, how exactly are you going to teach me how to fight？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「In other words, I don’t need a Sensei at all！」

name: Iori
message: 「Well now, I wonder about that！！」
I swung my Origami toward my back with all my might.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ouch... wait, my Origami—！」
Unable to fully parry my blow, Ririmu’s Origami slipped from her hand and tumbled to the ground.
Immediately, Ririmu’s appearance returned to normal. Without her Origami, she could no longer activate her Tenju.

name: Iori
message: 「Can I call that a match？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ah... yeah, fair enough！ I lose, I lose—total defeat！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You’re amazing, Sensei！ That last strike was seriously heavy, that was wild！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Also, were you actually able to see my attacks？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I couldn’t see them. It was just a hunch.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「No way~！ There’s no way you could’ve countered without seeing them！」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m serious. Ririmu, your illusions were perfect. I don’t think an average swordsman could stand a chance against that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Right? That was the first time someone’s countered me like that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「My last teacher was totally useless; he’d get all confused by my illusions and couldn't do a thing.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So there was nothing for me to learn from a guy like that, right？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But you’re different, Iorin. You actually managed to counter my attacks.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I think I might actually be down to take your class, Iorin.」

name: Iori
message: 「For real? Then will you show up to class starting tomorrow?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You bet, I’m there~！」
Oh… Yes! First one down, I've managed to win over a student!
The rumors say the Takamura Class is nothing but unmanageable troublemakers, so I was bracing myself for the worst.
But now that I've talked to her, she seems like a bright, easygoing, and good kid.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Alright then, Teach, you better come up with a way for me to get stronger by tomorrow」

name: Ririmu
message: 「If I like it, I'll actually show up to class every day」

name: Iori
message: 「Huh？ If you like it... wait...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So, I'm counting on you, Iorin！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, wait!」
After that one-sided declaration, Ririmu headed off somewhere.
